#### Leadership

## Leadingourmissiontoquantifycyberrisk

The leadership team at CyberCube is driving our collective mission to quantify cyber risk. The team embodies our core values to achieve this goal and reshape the boundaries of cyber risk.

With backgrounds ranging from insurance and risk modeling to cyber security and artificial intelligence (AI), this multi-disciplinary team endeavors to empower our clients to navigate the shifting cyber landscape and deliver exceptional outcomes.

The team brings their cutting-edge experience from world-class public and private sector institutions — allowing CyberCube to drive decision-making, manage risk, and build cyber resilience.
